milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing to check the player is near a grass_block on the ground and facing toward it. Grass blocks are the ground surface outside the building. The player spawns on grass, so they just need to look down at it. Target is set to (0, -1, 0) which is directly below spawn. max_distance=5 is generous since grass is everywhere. facing_tolerance=90 allows looking generally downward/toward the ground.

Uses position_near_with_facing to check the player has navigated inside the building's first room and is near the potted lily of the valley while facing it. The potted lily is at spawn-relative (-2, 1, 5) on an oak stair shelf inside the first room. max_distance=5 means the player must enter the building and get close. facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are looking toward the flower pot.

Uses position_near_with_facing to check the player has navigated to the back room of the building and is near the cyan wall banner while facing it. The banner is at spawn-relative (5, 2, 12) on the east wall of the back room, facing west. max_distance=5 means the player must enter the back room. facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are looking toward the banner on the wall.
